resume_bullets:
- Built a leakage-tested walk-forward backtest of 15 volatility and VaR/ES models on 7 assets over 19 years in Python; XGBoost did not beat GARCH-type models on volatility (statistically tied in a Model Confidence Set).
- Diagnosed why fat-tailed GARCH breached 99% VaR on equity indices and tested a pre-registered skewness fix: exceedances moved SPX 1.0%->1.1%, TSX 1.1%->1.1% (target 1%); hypothesis not supported.
- Validated 99%/97.5% VaR and ES with Kupiec, Christoffersen, Basel traffic-light and Acerbi-Szekely tests: GJR-GARCH-t was most reliable (14/14 checks passed); RiskMetrics EWMA breached 99% VaR 1.7x as often as expected in COVID.
- Served daily volatility/VaR/ES forecasts via a Dockerized FastAPI service refreshed by GitHub Actions; documented results in a bank-style model validation report.
